correctness.rationale: σ_k^{-1} prime-power values are -(1+p^k), p^k, and 0 for exponents 1,2,≥3. Prime-cube cases have J_k+3>4^k+3; squarefree even cases are growing sums of two positive products; squarefree odd cases have growing difference D_r-2. For cube-free nonsquarefree n=ab², F=b^k[μ(a)σ_k(a)+J_k(a)J_k(b)]+3 with coprime squarefree a,b. For μ(a)=1 direct lower bound yields equality at a=1,b=2 only; for μ(a)=-1, σ_k(a)/J_k(a)<ζ(k)²/ζ(2k)≤5/2 yields T>2^k, including the delicate b=2,k=2 strict endpoint. Independent divisor-convolution calculations n<600 for k=2,3,4 show minima (19,4),(67,4),(259,4). Finite checks corroborate an all-exponent proof.
residual_risks: Statement requires integer k≥2; n=1 has F=6 and is excluded; primes are zeros.
